action_description: Replaced the parent three-kernel metadata path with one device-side active-expert schedule that builds active_experts, active_offsets, compact active_counts, grouped_slots, token_counts, and active_expert_count. GEMM2/finalize now launches over min(E_local, T * TOPK) and guards blockIdx.y against active_expert_count[0] before reading active expert metadata, with no host active-count copy or synchronization. The existing warp-sliced GEMM1 path and vectorized GEMM2 arithmetic were kept unchanged.
